id: title:Gilbert09:don t report transient s3 timeouts during query folder cleanup

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion cleanup: distinguishes transient S3 connection errors from other errors, avoiding unnecessary error-tracking for transient issues.
review.reason: Adds a helper function and conditional check to distinguish transient S3 connection errors from other errors, skipping unnecessary exception tracking for transient network blips. This improves warehouse ingestion reliability by preventing false-positive error handling.
review.uncertainty: The benefit relies on the distinction between transient and permanent errors being correctly implemented and not causing false negatives; no test results or production metrics are available to verify the actual reduction in transient error handling or recovery behavior.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a test and implementation change. P1.F2.H3 and P1.F2.H2 show the production implementation. P1.F1.H1 and P1.F1.H2 are tests. No score assigned.
